title: 机场与入境
purpose: 值机、安检登机、入境海关，一个人出国也不慌

lines.en: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?
lines.zh: 早上好。您今天飞往哪里？

lines.en: Good morning. I'm flying to London.
lines.zh: 早上好。我飞伦敦。

lines.en: May I see your passport, please?
lines.zh: 请出示一下您的护照好吗？

lines.en: Sure, here you are.
lines.zh: 好的，给您。

lines.en: Thank you. Are you checking any bags today?
lines.zh: 谢谢。您今天要托运行李吗？

lines.en: Yes, just this suitcase.
lines.zh: 要，就这一个行李箱。

lines.en: Please put it on the scale. It's twenty-two kilos, so that's fine.
lines.zh: 请把它放到秤上。二十二公斤，没问题。

lines.en: Great. Could I have a window seat, please?
lines.zh: 太好了。请问我可以要一个靠窗的座位吗？

lines.en: Of course. Here's your boarding pass. Your seat is 24A.
lines.zh: 当然。这是您的登机牌，座位是24A。

lines.en: Thank you. Which gate do I go to?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我应该去哪个登机口？

lines.en: Gate 15. Boarding starts at ten forty.
lines.zh: 15号登机口。十点四十开始登机。

lines.en: Thanks a lot!
lines.zh: 非常感谢！

lines.en: I'm afraid your suitcase is overweight. It's twenty-six kilos.
lines.zh: 恐怕您的行李箱超重了，有二十六公斤。

lines.en: Oh no. What's the limit?
lines.zh: 哦不。限重是多少？

lines.en: The limit is twenty-three kilos. You can pay a fee or take some things out.
lines.zh: 限重二十三公斤。您可以付费，或者拿出一些东西。

lines.en: I'll take some things out and put them in my carry-on bag.
lines.zh: 我拿些东西出来放到随身行李里。

lines.en: That's fine. Remember, no liquids over one hundred millilitres in your carry-on.
lines.zh: 可以。记住，随身行李里不能有超过一百毫升的液体。

lines.en: OK. I'll move my books, then.
lines.zh: 好的，那我把书挪过去。

lines.en: Let's weigh it again. Twenty-three kilos. Perfect!
lines.zh: 我们再称一下。二十三公斤，正好！

lines.en: Phew! Is the flight on time?
lines.zh: 呼！航班准点吗？

lines.en: Yes, it's on time. Have a good flight!
lines.zh: 是的，准点。祝您旅途愉快！

lines.en: Thank you very much.
lines.zh: 非常感谢。

words.c: 请把您的包和夹克放进托盘。

words.e: OK. Do I need to take my laptop out?
words.c: 好的。我需要把笔记本电脑拿出来吗？

words.e: Should I take off my shoes too?
words.c: 我也要脱鞋吗？

words.e: Please fasten your seat belt. We'll take off in five minutes.
words.c: 请系好安全带。我们五分钟后起飞。

words.e: Please put your bag and jacket in the tray.

words.e: Is this your bag? There's a bottle of water in it.
words.c: 这是您的包吗？里面有一瓶水。

words.e: You have to throw away your drink before security.
words.c: 过安检前你得把饮料扔掉。

words.e: Please go to the boarding gate thirty minutes before departure.
words.c: 请在起飞前三十分钟到登机口。

words.e: Listen! There's an announcement about our flight.
words.c: 听！有一条关于我们航班的广播。

words.e: This is the final call for flight BA 168 to London.
words.c: 这是飞往伦敦的BA168航班最后一次登机广播。

words.e: Excuse me, is this the queue for Gate 15?
words.c: 打扰一下，这是15号登机口的队伍吗？

words.e: My seat is in row 24.
words.c: 我的座位在第24排。

words.e: Please fasten your seat belt. We'll take off in five minutes.
words.c: 请系好安全带。我们五分钟后起飞。

words.e: No problem. Could you help me put my bag in the overhead locker?
words.c: 没关系。您能帮我把包放进头顶的行李舱吗？

words.e: The flight attendant brought me some water.
words.c: 空乘人员给我拿了些水。

words.e: Could I have a blanket, please?
words.c: 请给我一条毯子好吗？

words.e: Excuse me, what time do we land in London?
words.c: 打扰一下，我们几点在伦敦降落？

words.e: Should I take off my shoes too?

words.e: The crew will serve dinner soon.
words.c: 机组人员很快会供应晚餐。

lines.en: Please put your bag and jacket in the tray.
lines.zh: 请把您的包和夹克放进托盘。

lines.en: OK. Do I need to take my laptop out?
lines.zh: 好的。我需要把笔记本电脑拿出来吗？

lines.en: Yes, put it in a separate tray, please.
lines.zh: 是的，请放到单独的托盘里。

lines.en: Should I take off my shoes too?
lines.zh: 我也要脱鞋吗？

lines.en: No, that's fine. Please empty your pockets and walk through the scanner.
lines.zh: 不用。请把口袋掏空，然后走过扫描仪。

lines.en: Sure.
lines.zh: 好的。

lines.en: Is this your bag? There's a bottle of water in it.
lines.zh: 这是您的包吗？里面有一瓶水。

lines.en: Oh, sorry, I forgot about it.
lines.zh: 哦，对不起，我忘了。

lines.en: You can drink it now or throw it away.
lines.zh: 您可以现在喝掉或者扔掉。

lines.en: I'll throw it away. Can I go now?
lines.zh: 我扔掉吧。我可以走了吗？

lines.en: Yes, you're all done. Have a nice trip.
lines.zh: 可以，都好了。祝您旅途愉快。

lines.en: Welcome on board. May I see your boarding pass?
lines.zh: 欢迎登机。请出示您的登机牌好吗？

lines.en: Here it is.
lines.zh: 给您。

lines.en: 24A. It's down this aisle on the left.
lines.zh: 24A，沿着这条过道往前走，在左边。

lines.en: Excuse me, I think you're in my seat. It's 24A.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我想您坐了我的座位，是24A。

lines.en: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'm in 24C.
lines.zh: 哦，真抱歉，我是24C。

lines.en: No problem. Could you help me put my bag in the overhead locker?
lines.zh: 没关系。您能帮我把包放进头顶的行李舱吗？

lines.en: Of course. There you go.
lines.zh: 当然。放好了。

lines.en: Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 太谢谢您了。

lines.en: Please fasten your seat belt. We'll take off in five minutes.
lines.zh: 请系好安全带。我们五分钟后起飞。

lines.en: Excuse me, what time do we land in London?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我们几点在伦敦降落？

lines.en: At about six p.m. local time.
lines.zh: 大约当地时间下午六点。

words.e: After you land, follow the signs to immigration.
words.c: 落地后，跟着指示牌去入境检查处。

words.e: The border officer asked me a few questions.
words.c: 边检官员问了我几个问题。

words.e: What's the purpose of your visit?
words.c: 您来访的目的是什么？

words.e: I need a student visa to study there for a year.
words.c: 去那里学习一年需要学生签证。

words.e: How long are you staying?
words.c: 您要待多久？

words.e: With a host family. Here's their address.
words.c: 住在寄宿家庭。这是他们的地址。

words.e: With a host family. Here's their address.
words.c: 住在寄宿家庭。这是他们的地址。

words.e: Do you have a return ticket?
words.c: 您有返程机票吗？

words.e: Please put your finger on the scanner for your fingerprint.
words.c: 请把手指放在扫描仪上录指纹。

words.e: We went through customs quickly.
words.c: 我们很快就过了海关。

words.e: I have nothing to declare.
words.c: 我没有要申报的物品。

words.e: I have nothing to declare.
words.c: 我没有要申报的物品。

words.e: Where is the baggage claim?
words.c: 行李提取处在哪里？

words.e: Our bags will come out on carousel 5.
words.c: 我们的行李会在5号转盘出来。

words.e: Go to the lost luggage desk if your bag doesn't arrive.
words.c: 如果你的包没到，去行李丢失柜台。

words.e: My host family will wait for me in the arrivals hall.
words.c: 我的寄宿家庭会在到达大厅等我。

words.e: My host dad will pick me up at the airport.
words.c: 我的寄宿爸爸会到机场接我。

words.e: We'll arrive at six p.m. local time.
words.c: 我们将在当地时间下午六点到达。

words.e: It's my first time in a foreign country.
words.c: 这是我第一次来外国。

words.e: Please fill in this form with your address and phone number.
words.c: 请在这张表格上填写您的地址和电话号码。

words.e: The currency in the UK is the pound.
words.c: 英国的货币是英镑。

patterns.en: I'm here to study English for a year.
patterns.sit: 边检官员问你来干什么

patterns.en: Here's the address of my host family.
patterns.zh: 这是我寄宿家庭的地址。
patterns.sit: 官员要看你住处的地址

patterns.en: I'll stay for about three months.
patterns.sit: 官员问你要待多久

patterns.en: I have nothing to declare.
patterns.sit: 海关问你有没有要申报的东西

lines.en: Next, please. Passport, please.
lines.zh: 下一位。请出示护照。

lines.en: Here you are.
lines.zh: 给您。

lines.en: What's the purpose of your visit?
lines.zh: 您来访的目的是什么？

lines.en: I'm here to study. I'm going to a summer school.
lines.zh: 我来学习，我要去上暑期学校。

lines.en: How long are you staying?
lines.zh: 您要待多久？

lines.en: Four weeks.
lines.zh: 四周。

lines.en: Where will you stay?
lines.zh: 您住在哪里？

lines.en: With a host family. Here's their address.
lines.zh: 住在寄宿家庭。这是他们的地址。

lines.en: Do you have a return ticket?
lines.zh: 您有返程机票吗？

lines.en: Yes, I fly back on August the twentieth.
lines.zh: 有，我八月二十日飞回去。

lines.en: OK. Please look at the camera. ... Welcome to the UK.
lines.zh: 好的，请看摄像头。……欢迎来到英国。

lines.en: Thank you!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.en: Excuse me, my suitcase didn't come out.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我的行李箱没有出来。

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Which flight were you on?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。您坐的是哪个航班？

lines.en: Flight CA 937 from Beijing.
lines.zh: 从北京来的CA937航班。

lines.en: Can I see your baggage tag? It's usually on your boarding pass.
lines.zh: 我能看看您的行李牌吗？一般贴在登机牌上。

lines.en: Here it is.
lines.zh: 在这儿。

lines.en: What does your suitcase look like?
lines.zh: 您的行李箱是什么样子的？

lines.en: It's a big blue suitcase with a yellow label.
lines.zh: 是一个大的蓝色行李箱，上面有黄色标签。

lines.en: Please fill in this form with your address and phone number.
lines.zh: 请在这张表格上填写您的地址和电话号码。

lines.en: OK. When will I get it back?
lines.zh: 好的。我什么时候能拿回来？

lines.en: Usually within two days. We'll deliver it to your address.
lines.zh: 通常两天之内。我们会送到您的地址。

lines.en: That's a relief. Thank you for your help.
lines.zh: 那我就放心了。谢谢您的帮助。
